image_description: A brown pelican floating on rippled water, viewed from a high angle. The bird has dark brown/grey plumage on its back and wings, with a lighter tan/brown head and neck. Its distinctive long bill with a gular pouch is visible, pointing towards the right. A small portion of another bird's wing is visible in the bottom left corner.
